description: Connect DataFluxor to research Google search results and inspect public websites from ChatGPT. Tools cover organic SERP results, autocomplete suggestions, index checks, page metadata, bounded technical SEO crawls, SERP volatility, competitor keyword comparisons, AI Overview visibility, and retained runs. Sign in to your own DataFluxor workspace with OAuth. An existing paid plan and credits are required; each paid tool states its credit cost. Results come from public search and web pages requested by the user. Tool availability follows the workspace plan and permissions.

defaultPrompt: Show the top 10 organic Google results in the UK for 'technical SEO audit' and summarize which domains repeat.
Crawl at most five pages of https://example.com and list technical SEO issues, including failed pages.
Compare example.com and example.org for the keywords 'seo tools' and 'serp api' and explain where each ranks.
